name: Emanuel Cleaver
note: Share of substantive votes cast against the member's own party majority, share of cosponsorships given to the other party's bills, and share of their own bills that drew cross-party cosponsors. Percentile is the share of the other 431 scored House members this member's average ranks above.
caveats: Cosponsorship reach is measured over the most recent 50 cosponsorships on file (the Congress.gov per-member list is capped), not a member's full record.
Cross-party support counts only sponsored bills whose cosponsor list was fetched.
Procedural and amendment votes are excluded, matching the alignment scoring.
